name: VeriFlow
description: Pay-per-signal crypto risk-regime signals (RISK_ON / RISK_OFF for BTC and ETH) for AI agents, sold over x402 in CCD. Every signal is committed on Concordium as a SHA-256 hash before its outcome is known, so the track record cannot be edited or cherry-picked. Buyers first prove with Concordium Verify & Access V1 (zero-knowledge) that they are 18+ and not resident in a restricted country; VeriFlow learns nothing else. Not investment advice.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status is Active + card SHA-256 equals metadata_hash.

skills.name: Buy a signal
skills.description: Pay about 1 CCD over x402 for the latest RISK_ON / RISK_OFF signal for BTC or ETH; returns the signal, its commitment and the Concordium anchor transaction.

skills.name: Verify a signal
skills.description: Read a commitment back from Concordium and check that the signal content hashes to it.

skills.name: Track record
skills.description: Hit rate of all signals whose 7-day horizon has passed, each committed on-chain before its outcome.

skills.name: Check buyer eligibility
skills.description: Whether a Concordium account has passed the zero-knowledge eligibility check (Verify & Access V1).
